title: Entralink run
description: How a run of the Entralink roguelike is laid out (docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-roguelike-prototype.md): its rounds, each a number of rooms whose types its doors draw by the round's type_weights, from rooms/ (role room, kept to that round or to none) or templates/, then for the first two an optional boss (role boss) and for the last the final room (role final), each after the pre-boss rest. Rooms are drawn without repeats while unused ones fit; then the least used come up again, never one twice in a row. tools/paperwhite2/entralink_run.py checks it and writes it into paperwhite2/entralink_run_config.h.

rounds.description: Rounds 1, 2 and 3 in order; the final room follows the last. At most 20 rooms in all, the pre-boss rests (one before each boss and the final room) and the final included

room_maps.description: The zones of the rooms before the final one, taken in turn; each needs a bottom exit, where a room is entered

pre_boss_map.description: The zone of the room played just before a boss or the final room, a clearing with only north and south exits, whose north door leads to the boss; left out, the room maps, with only the north door open

unknown_chance.description: The chance, in percent, that a door to a room of role room shows the unknown marker (???) whatever is behind it, rolled as the player enters the room with the door; 5 if left out

marker_spots.description: Where each forward door's marker lies, 2 by 2 tiles from its top-left tile, on the clearings' shared 32 by 32 grid; left out, north 15, 12, east 21, 16 and west 9, 16. NPCs should keep off them

custom_chance.description: The chance, in percent, that a door whose type is rest, item, buff or shop leads to a premade room of that type (rooms/, if one fits) instead of the type's template (templates/<type>.json); 25 if left out

ground_item_chance.description: The chance, in percent, that a room with no item or item_choice NPC has a ball on the ground holding an item of items.json's ground pool, on a random free tile; 30 if left out

hidden_item_chance.description: The chance, in percent, that a room has a hidden item of items.json's ground pool on one of its clearing's flower tiles (flower_tiles.json), found by pressing A facing it; 20 if left out

dust.description: The Dream Dust (the run's currency, spent in its shops, none at its start and lost at its end) a battle won gives, by its room: an enemy, enemy_choice or challenge room's (a battle in a room of another type gives an enemy room's), a boss's or the final room's; times its round's dust_round_percent. A caught enemy counts as a win. Left out: enemy 40, enemy_choice 50, challenge 80, boss 150, final 0

dust_round_percent.description: The percent of dust a battle gives in rounds 1, 2 and 3 (a boss's in its round's, the final room's in the last's); a round left out takes the last one given. 100, 150, 200 if left out

shop_items.description: How many different items a shop sells, drawn from items.json's shop pool (its weights and rounds, the Nightmare Ball only while something can be caught) as the player enters its room, at their price in Dream Dust; 5 if left out

swap_dust.description: The Dream Dust a rest stop's swap NPC (type swap) takes for bringing a Pokémon of the Reserve Box into the team in place of one of the run's copies; 100 if left out

reserve_slots.description: How many Pokémon the Reserve Box holds: the PC Box Pokémon the player sets aside in the hub (its NPC) for rest stops' swaps, saved as links to them; 6 if left out

field_weather.description: The forest's field weather (include/system/zone_weather.h) in the rounds with no field_weather of their own, the hack's tints (WEATHER_CUSTOM_TINT_*, res/paperwhite2/field_tints/tints.json) among them; the forest's own if left out

enemy_scaling.description: How the enemies' stats grow with the run's depth (entralink-buffs.md, section 12; tools/paperwhite2/entralink_sim.py simulates a run with them): each stat's multiplier in percent, applied at a run battle's start to the enemies' stats (a caught one keeps its own). A round's room n (from 0) multiplies by rooms + n x room_step, its boss, the final room and any raid by boss; then each enemy's own scale (room data). A stat left out stays 100

rooms.description: How many rooms of role room are drawn for it, from those kept to it and the generic ones; when unused ones run out, rooms come up again

boss.description: Rounds 1 and 2: whether a boss room ends it, drawn from the boss rooms kept to it, else from the generic ones; false if left out. A boss, and the final room, come after the pre-boss rest (templates/pre_boss_rest.json)

field_weather.description: The field weather (a fog) of the round's rooms, its boss's and, for the last round, the final room's; left out, the run's field_weather

type_weights.description: The weight of each room type a forward door of the round draws (never two rest rooms in a row, no rest or shop just before the pre-boss rest, a type with no room skipped); a type left out takes its default: enemy 42, enemy_choice 8, challenge 12, item 10, buff 10, rest 10, event 5, shop 3

scaling.description: A stat's multipliers in percent, one value a round (rounds 1, 2, 3; a round left out takes the last one given). Max HP stops at 65,535

rooms.description: In a round's first room; 100 if left out

room_step.description: Added for each later room of the round; 0 if left out

boss.description: For the round's boss (round 3's: the final room) and a raid in the round; 100 if left out

spot.description: x, z: the marker's top-left tile
